_doc: Audit 4 punch list (55804c2): self-citing rules, a misattributed quote, retired-register pointers, grammar. The quote-integrity half (ruling-title descriptors) is fixed at its source: adopted.mjs shortTitle marks every cut; absorb.mjs rewrites 'the pre-R<n> X'.

edits.find: (D-U16-1). The engine takes a unit's printed attributes first, in type-line order, then those from its mods in the order the mods were applied, then those its column shares with it, front to back, so it balances first (CR 709.4b calls this order its own;
edits.replace: (D-U16-1). The engine takes a unit's printed attributes first, in type-line order, then those from its mods in the order the mods were applied, then those its column shares with it, front to back, so it balances first (the owner ruling of 2026-08-18 calls this order the engine's own reading;
edits.why: [self-cite] CR 709.4b cited itself (recite mapped R19, the ruling this rule absorbed, onto the rule). R19 called the order 'the engine's reading'; wording only, the claim is unchanged — the record needs a re-verify
